why: RJ-P70, pending OC-12 (suiteui/orientation-crop): Photo's catalog has no image.flip until OC-12, so platforms is [] and the harness skips the job on both. On a 48 x 32 gradient with a 16 x 10 patch layer at (6, 4) above it, flips the whole canvas horizontally and exports the PNG. The trap: only the selected layer flips, or the patch keeps its old offset so the composite shifts. The assertion: the PNG equals the original PNG mirrored, pixel for pixel (PhotoOrientationTests.flipCanvasRealJob). The turn-on sets platforms to linux and macos.
